text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you again 
this year. I'd be thrilled if we can join 
forces and do our best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Without further ado, would you 
accompany me for the New Year's events?
choice_data_list:
A New Year's tradition— you mean 
hatsumode?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No, before praying to the gods—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd write out my aspirations for 
kakizome. There's a New Year's calligraphy 
contest being held at the academy, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-saaann!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Are you doing first calligraphy too, 
Ayabe-san? If so, let's go together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ………… ...I don't really mind, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega is a girl of few words. Even 
so, in her own way, it seems she has 
opened up a little to Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, if it isn't Top Road-san and 
Ayabe-san! HAPPY NEW OVERLORD!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Are you doing the first calligraphy of 
the new year too? Well, if you insist on 
accompanying me, then by all means!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O-chan...! Yes, let's go together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't really mind, but you're always so 
high and mighty, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'd be happy to accompany you too~.
choice_data_list: Meisho Doto... what's with that outfit?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa, by mistake, I ended up wearing 
my Halloween costume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, despite the hectic rush, the five 
of us headed to the New Year's calligraphy 
venue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, let us get to work. By the way, Top 
Road-san, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "What is your first goal for this year?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The first... of the year. Opera O-chan, 
have you already decided?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course. My first goal for this year is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho is mine! Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho. It's the race that serves 
as the first leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Classic Triple Crown. This refers to 
the three most prestigious GⅠ races that 
countless Classic-tier Umamusume aim for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho. Narita Top Road will likely 
head in that direction as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho...? Opera O, do you 
realize what you're saying? I mean, 
you're...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She's still a maiden, right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really~? Was that so? Well, just being 
alive is a grand victory for me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san has already made her debut, 
she's so impressive~. While I haven't even 
run in a race yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though they were of the same generation, 
their standings were all different. And 
so, each decided to write their own New 
Year's calligraphy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's done! Take a look! This is 
what I wrote!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Straight ahead"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to head straight ahead. What do 
you think?
choice_data_list:
That's a great phrase, perfectly suited 
for the first calligraphy of the year.

That's a great phrase, perfectly suited 
for the first calligraphy of the year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the neat handwriting, Narita Top 
Road's earnest determination comes through 
loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's keep our eyes fixed ahead and 
move forward together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what kind of words did 
everyone else write?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I am a little curious. I'd kind of like to 
see it for reference...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That could certainly be helpful. Whose 
calligraphy should I ask to see?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mass production...? Ah, you're right. 
Opera O-chan is writing away at an 
incredible pace.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, not like this! Not like that either! 
Then—how about this?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I finally finished writing it! A gem 
of a phrase that'll make even Puccini 
dance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decide to ask to see those words. The 
message T.M. Opera O wrote with her brush 
was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Ba"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In short, the 'Ro' in 'Rose.' Doesn't 
it suit me perfectly?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to bloom beautifully this year, 
just like this calligraphy piece.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-If anything, why not write out the whole 
word "Rose", or write it in kanji...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Kanji! Hahaha, fussing over complicated 
details isn't in my nature!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which character should I write 
next? "Ra" after all, perhaps? Or going in 
the ba-bi-bu-be-bo order, "Bi"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Babi." Yup, I have no idea what that 
means!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O laughs it off. It was utterly 
chaotic from start to finish, but her 
vitality is truly something to learn from.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan...? Ah, that's right, she's over 
there leisurely writing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, hasn't she frozen up in front 
of the calligraphy paper? Did something 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Top Road-san~. Actually, um...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you've already written it down. 
What you wrote is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is this... a picture, not writing? Is 
it a... puddle?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, I ended up spilling India 
ink everywhere with a big splat~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, since we're here, I'm debating 
whether I should write my name on the 
side."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see! That's so interesting. 
Turning an accidental creation into a 
piece of art!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's so heartwarming. Both this kakizome, 
and Doto-chan for coming up with it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so...? Ehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto blushed with embarrassment. 
This heartwarming exchange so early in the 
New Year left me with a warm, fuzzy 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Shall we take a look at Ayabe-san's? 
Somehow, she looks like she'd have 
wonderful calligraphy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can definitely see that image. I decided 
to ask to see what she had written.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, this handwriting is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's 'Sacrifice'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It means 'to dedicate.' Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't that normal? We run to dedicate 
our victories to someone."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why I wrote it. ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega doesn't say much. She must 
have entrusted all her feelings to the 
written word.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Ayabe-san. You're wonderfully 
skilled, I'm truly moved!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, huh... A "stick"? Ayabe-san, you 
want a stick? What for?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need it. But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Now, I want it. Just so I can smack you 
with it."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Then instead of a staff, a 
spear would be far more fitting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden comedy routine broke out. Yet 
Admire Vega's calligraphy was truly 
elegant, serving as great inspiration.
